nuvel-orgmemory.description: Nuvel OrgMemory — Semantica-based knowledge graph for team architecture decisions, coding standards, component documentation, and past incidents.

tools.search_knowledge: Search OrgMemory for architecture decisions, standards, component docs, and incidents by keyword or topic.
tools.get_decision: Retrieve a specific Architecture Decision Record (ADR) by ID.
tools.list_decisions: List all ADRs, optionally filtered by component, status, or date range.
tools.get_standard: Retrieve a specific coding standard or convention document.
tools.list_standards: List all coding standards, optionally filtered by language or category.
tools.get_component: Retrieve detailed documentation for a specific component.
tools.search_incidents: Search past incident reports by keyword, component, or date.
tools.create_decision: Record a new Architecture Decision Record (ADR) in OrgMemory.
tools.log_incident: Log a new incident or learning in OrgMemory.
